title: From Logs to Faults: Reference-Free Fault Localization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines
title_zh: 从日志到故障：面向检索增强生成流水线的无参考故障定位

paragraphs.en: RAGLog利用执行日志无需参考答案即可定位RAG流水线故障，已开源且成本更低。 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are widely used for domain-specific question answering, yet locating faults remains manual and time-consuming. Fault localization is challenging because RAG pipelines consist of interdependent stages, where faults can propagate downstream, masking their origin, or remain undetected even when the final answer is correct. Existing evaluation approaches often focus on individual stages and rely on reference answers or code instrumentation. We present RAGLog, which detects and localizes faults across RAG stages using execution logs, without requiring reference answers or code instrumentation. RAGLog transforms heterogeneous API logs into a common RAG schema and combines rule-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based checks to identify faulty stages. We introduce a live fault injector and RAGLog Faults, a dataset of 3,134 runs from five RAG pipelines with stage-level fault labels. With Claude Haiku 5.5, RAGLog achieves a pooled F1 score of 0.73 on runs with naturally occurring faults, outperforming Claude Code (0.58) and Codex (0.52), and comparable effectiveness on runs with injected faults (0.84 versus 0.80 and 0.82, respectively). It analyzes runs in approximately five seconds at US\$0.005 each, with overall lower cost and latency than agent baselines. RAGLog is available as an open-source tool for debugging, evaluating, and monitoring RAG pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: RAGLog利用执行日志，无需参考答案即可定位RAG流水线故障，已开源且成本更低。检索增强生成（RAG）流水线被广泛用于特定领域问答，但故障定位仍然依赖人工且耗时。 故障定位之所以具有挑战性，是因为RAG流水线由相互依赖的阶段组成，故障可能向下游传播而掩盖其来源，或者即使在最终答案正确时也未被察觉。 现有的评估方法通常只关注单个阶段，并且依赖参考答案或代码插桩。 我们提出RAGLog，它利用执行日志在RAG各阶段间检测并定位故障，无需参考答案或代码插桩。 RAGLog将异构的API日志转换为统一的RAG模式，并结合基于规则、基于嵌入和基于LLM的检查来识别故障阶段。 我们引入了一个实时故障注入器以及RAGLog Faults——一个包含来自五个RAG流水线的3,134次运行、带有阶段级故障标签的数据集。 使用Claude Haiku 5.5时，RAGLog在具有自然发生故障的运行上取得了0.73的合并F1分数，优于Claude Code（0.58）和Codex（0.52），并且在具有注入故障的运行上也具有相当的效果（0.84，而Claude Code和Codex分别为0.80和0.82）。 它分析一次运行约需五秒钟，每次成本为0.005美元，总体成本和延迟均低于智能体基线。 RAGLog作为一个开源工具提供，可用于调试、评估和监控RAG流水线。
